ei.title: 올림포스 전국연합 기출문제집 영어독해 고2 (2026) 3강 Ex04 워크북
ei.subject: 영어

fullPassage: Merely convincing your children that worry is senseless and that they would be more content if they didn't worry isn't going to stop them from worrying. For some reason, young people seem to believe that worry is a fact of life over which they have little or no control. Consequently, they don't even try to stop. Therefore, you need to convince them that worry, like guilt and fear, is nothing more than an emotion, and like all emotions, is subject to the power of the will. Tell them that they can eliminate worry from their lives by simply refusing to attend to it. Explain to them that if they refuse to act worried regardless of how they feel, they will eventually stop feeling worried and will begin to experience the contentment that accompanies a worry-free life.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 아이들에게 걱정이 무의미하고 걱정하지 않으면 더 만족할 것이라고 단지 설득하는 것만으로는 그들이 걱정을 멈추게 하지 못할 것이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① convincing: 동명사 주어로 올바름 (Merely convincing ~ isn't going to...)
✅ ② senselessly → senseless: be동사(is)의 보어 자리이므로 형용사 senseless가 맞음. 부사 senselessly는 문법 오류
❌ ③ subject: be subject to ~의 형용사 용법으로 올바름
❌ ④ refusing: by + 동명사 전치사구로 올바름
det.tip: be동사 뒤에는 형용사(보어)가 오고, 일반동사를 수식할 때는 부사가 옵니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 젊은 사람들은 걱정이 자신이 거의 혹은 전혀 통제할 수 없는 삶의 사실이라고 믿는 것 같다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① worrying: stop + 동명사(~하는 것을 멈추다)로 올바름
❌ ② believe: 주어 young people에 맞는 동사 원형으로 올바름
✅ ③ what → which: 선행사 a fact of life가 있으므로 관계대명사 which가 맞음. what은 선행사를 포함하므로 오류
❌ ④ worried: feel worried(걱정스러워하다)에서 형용사 역할로 올바름
det.tip: 선행사가 있으면 which/that, 선행사가 없으면 what을 씁니다.

questions.passage: Merely convincing your children that worry is senseless and that they would be more ①<u>content</u> if they didn't worry isn't going to stop them from worrying. Therefore, you need to convince them that worry, like guilt and fear, is ②<u>nothing</u> more than an emotion, and like all emotions, is subject to the power of the will. Tell them that they can ③<u>eliminate</u> worry from their lives by simply refusing to attend to it. Explain to them that if they refuse to act worried ④<u>regarding</u> of how they feel, they will eventually stop feeling worried and will begin to experience the contentment that accompanies a worry-free life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 그들이 어떻게 느끼든 상관없이 걱정하는 것처럼 행동하기를 거부하면, 결국 걱정하는 감정을 멈출 것이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① content: be more content에서 형용사로 올바름 (만족하는)
❌ ② nothing: nothing more than(~에 불과하다)에서 올바른 사용
❌ ③ eliminate: can eliminate에서 동사 원형으로 올바름
✅ ④ regarding → regardless: regardless of(~에 상관없이)가 올바른 표현. regarding은 '~에 관하여'라는 전혀 다른 의미
det.tip: regardless of = ~에 상관없이, regarding = ~에 관하여. 혼동 주의!

questions.passage: Merely convincing your children that worry is senseless and that they would be more content if they didn't worry ①<u>aren't</u> going to stop them from worrying. For some reason, young people ②<u>seem</u> to believe that worry is a fact of life over which they have little or no control. Consequently, they don't even try to stop. Therefore, you need to convince them that worry, like guilt and fear, is nothing more than an emotion, and like all ③<u>emotions</u>, is subject to the power of the will. Tell them that they can eliminate worry from their lives by simply refusing to attend to it. Explain to them that if they refuse to act worried regardless of how they feel, they will eventually stop feeling worried and will begin to experience the contentment that ④<u>accompanies</u> a worry-free life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 아이들에게 걱정이 무의미하다고 단지 설득하는 것만으로는 그들이 걱정을 멈추게 하지 못할 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① aren't → isn't: 주어가 동명사구 'Merely convincing your children ~'으로 단수 취급. aren't는 복수 동사이므로 오류
❌ ② seem: 주어 young people(복수)에 맞는 동사 원형으로 올바름
❌ ③ emotions: all emotions에서 복수 명사로 올바름
❌ ④ accompanies: 주어 that(= the contentment를 수식하는 관계절 아닌, 관계대명사 주격으로 선행사 contentment가 단수)이므로 올바름
det.tip: 동명사(구)가 주어일 때는 단수 취급하여 단수 동사를 씁니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 걱정은 감정에 불과하며, 의지의 힘에 의해 지배받는다. 걱정에 주의를 기울이기를 거부함으로써 삶에서 걱정을 제거할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① senseless: 걱정이 '무의미한'이라는 의미로 문맥에 적절
❌ ② control: 통제할 수 없다는 맥락에서 적절
✅ ③ preserve(보존하다) → eliminate(제거하다): 걱정을 삶에서 '제거'할 수 있다는 문맥이므로 '보존하다'는 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ contentment: 걱정 없는 삶에 따르는 '만족감'으로 적절
det.tip: eliminate(제거하다) ↔ preserve(보존하다)는 반의어 관계입니다.

questions.passage: Merely convincing your children that worry is senseless and that they would be more content if they didn't worry isn't going to stop them from worrying. For some reason, young people seem to believe that worry is a fact of life over which they have little or no control. Consequently, they don't even try to stop. Therefore, you need to ①<u>convince</u> them that worry, like guilt and fear, is nothing more than an emotion, and like all emotions, is ②<u>immune</u> to the power of the will. Tell them that they can eliminate worry from their lives by simply refusing to ③<u>attend</u> to it. Explain to them that if they refuse to act worried regardless of how they feel, they will eventually stop feeling worried and will begin to ④<u>experience</u> the contentment that accompanies a worry-free life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 걱정은 모든 감정과 마찬가지로 의지의 힘에 지배를 받는다. 걱정하는 것처럼 행동하기를 거부하면 만족감을 경험하기 시작할 것이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① convince: '설득하다'로 문맥에 적절 (아이들을 설득해야 한다)
✅ ② immune(면역이 있는) → subject(지배를 받는): be subject to(~에 지배를 받다)가 원문. be immune to(~에 면역이 있다)는 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ attend: attend to(~에 주의를 기울이다)로 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ experience: '경험하다'로 만족감을 경험한다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: be subject to = ~에 지배를 받다, be immune to = ~에 면역이 있다.

❌ ④ a source of fear: 걱정이 공포의 원인이라는 내용은 없음

✅ ④ simple → simply: 동명사 refusing을 수식하는 부사 자리이므로 simply가 맞음. 형용사 simple은 오류
❌ ③ eventually: will eventually stop에서 동사를 수식하는 부사로 올바름
det.tip: 동사/동명사를 수식할 때는 부사를, 명사를 수식할 때는 형용사를 씁니다.

questions.passage: Merely convincing your children that worry is senseless and that they would be more content if they didn't worry isn't going to stop them from worrying. For some reason, young people seem to believe that worry is a fact of life over which they have little or no control. Consequently, they don't even try to stop. Therefore, you need to convince them that worry, like guilt and fear, is nothing more than an emotion, and like all emotions, is subject to the power of the will. Tell them that they can eliminate worry from their lives by simply refusing to attend to it. Explain to them that if they refuse to act worried regardless of how they feel, they will eventually stop feeling worried and will begin to experience the contentment that accompanies a worry-free life.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 '아이들이 걱정에 대해 가지고 있는 잘못된 믿음'을 한 단어로 찾아 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 젊은 사람들은 걱정이 자신이 거의 또는 전혀 통제할 수 없는 삶의 사실이라고 믿는다.
det.analysis: 본문에서 젊은이들은 걱정을 'a fact of life over which they have little or no control'이라 믿는다. 이 잘못된 믿음의 핵심 단어는 control(통제)이며, 통제할 수 없다는 인식이 걱정을 멈추려 시도하지 않는 원인이다.
